basis: Current continuity through 19/01/0069 AC43. Dated derived replacements; original survey preserved.

changes.old: His parents now reside at the 56-hectare Orsival estate nearby, Galahad has returned to his Collegium room in Auvrienne to complete expedition preparations.
changes.new: His parents reside at the 56-hectare Orsival estate nearby. Following his 12–17/10 visit it has a telephone and two watchhounds. His private papers and former Collegium belongings arrived on 22/10. Galahad has returned to Auvrienne and been appointed Royal Advisor; five household rifles and 100 ordinary rounds have arrived.

changes.old: Institutional and professional connections support his expanding research.
changes.new: Institutional and professional connections support his research. Galahad resigned salaried Collegium employment on 20/10, donated patronage and moved his personal belongings to the estate. His allocated military works completed 192 accepted trial rifles and three development rifles by 02/11. Ordel manages the autonomous workshop pending Crown/military instructions; Galahad and Serault accompanied 187 military rifles to Cressault on 04/11, where company instruction began 05/11. Five House rifles have arrived at the estate. All seven training days concluded 11/11. Galahad and Serault returned on 12/11; the Margrave appointed him Royal Advisor with a standing Crown mandate for industry, infrastructure and defensive preparedness. The formal instrument is signed and delivered. Residence and administrative-cover rooms are allocated; the isolated Agency headquarters is under construction and its six members have trained and departed homeward.
